We often go to the library together. The photo club is big and clean. The story-writing desk is not far from my home. The streets are noisy during rush hour.
Nina and Kate are in the same class. I like my life very much. Nina's favorite season is autumn. In fact, they finished the thousand-piece puzzle.
Nina drinks juice every morning. Kate likes salad too. We talk about English a lot.
